headline: Your stream. Your chat.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Chrome Web Store small promotional tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen, one complete landscape design, 11:7 aspect ratio, 1760 x 1120 pixels. It will be viewed at only 440 x 280 pixels. Render only ONE design, not a contact sheet.
Primary request: sophisticated entertainment / VTuber fan-stream promotional art, striking and tasteful, like a fashionable editorial campaign. An original young adult anime host in a large expressive close-up fills the left 52% of the frame, looking cheerfully toward the right. Lavender hair with a small coral accent, a stylish modest black streetwear jacket, clean original character design. Absolutely no resemblance to existing VTubers, celebrities, or anime franchises.
Style: polished flat cel-shaded editorial anime illustration, beautiful purposeful graphic shapes and restrained linework; no shiny 3D rendering. Light lavender paper-colored background, coral red color blocks, near-black ink type, off-white highlights. The illustration should feel curated and attractive rather than childish.
Composition: asymmetrical magazine cover layout. On the upper right, spacious enormous near-black contemporary sans-serif typography, exactly two lines reading "Your stream." then "Your chat." Do not overlap her face. Tiny secondary label at the top left, exactly "LIVE CHAT FULLSCREEN". Keep every word inside the frame with comfortable margin.
At the lower right, a single wide illustrated video stage, drawn flat and straight-on, not a physical monitor or browser. Its colorful indie game landscape and small avatar inset imply a fullscreen livestream. Inside the right third of THIS stage show a simple dark chat overlay with only three widely-spaced short comments: "LET'S GO", "So good!", "Love this". Include an obvious wide bottom input field reading "Say something..." and a clean paper-plane send icon. It must be apparent that chat and input sit ON the stream, without an external sidebar. Make this lower video stage uncluttered and relatively wide. The main hero avatar and typography carry the design.
Constraints: original illustrative promotional UI, not an actual screenshot or a claim of a real creator's endorsement; crisp spelling; only the text specified; generous padding around chat lines and composer; no YouTube, Chrome or franchise logos; no badges, no charts, no repeated floating panels, no paragraphs. No gamer room, no physical screens, no cars, no neon tech grid, no gradient corporate SaaS visual, no glossy glass, no watermark.
editPrompt: Recompose this promotional design into a less-wide landscape rectangle with aspect ratio exactly 11:7 (1.5714:1), requested pixel size 1760 wide by 1120 tall. This is the shape of a Chrome Web Store 440 x 280 tile. The existing image is incorrectly panoramic (2.5:1). Create NEW artwork in the required taller rectangle. DO NOT return another panorama. Do not stretch or crop the existing artwork. Keep the same distinctive original lavender-haired anime adult character, lavender and coral palette, flat cel-shaded editorial finish, main headline exactly "Your stream." / "Your chat.", small brand label exactly "LIVE CHAT FULLSCREEN", and one illustrated stream stage with chat and a composer. Re-layout: original character left 47% filling height, headline on upper-right 53% at slightly smaller font so both lines fit within generous margins; the single wide game video stage on lower right is taller and occupies lower half, showing chat ON the game landscape. Reduce the repeated avatar inset size. Chat lines exactly "LET'S GO", "So good!", "Love this", input exactly "Say something..." and paper-plane icon. Retain quality, spacious type and clean padding. Entire composition should look intentionally designed for a chunky 11:7 rectangular tile rather than a website banner. No new content or extra text.
conceptNote: Original anime avatar in a lavender and coral editorial campaign, with a single illustrated full-screen stage and usable chat composer.
